summary: Solution is incomplete and non-functional. Workflow references non-existent test file (tests/SecretRotationValidator.Tests.ps1) and fixture file (fixtures/secrets.json). Code provided is high-quality (solid type validation, error handling, modular design, locale-independent date parsing, least-privilege permissions), but missing critical deliverables: no Pester tests (task requires TDD methodology + Invoke-Pester passing), no mock fixtures, no act validation run (task requires act-result.txt artifact with test output). Workflow will fail on unit-tests job and cannot proceed to validation. Unrunnable as-is.
